subject: Introduction to Mechanical Engineering
title: Machine Elements and Mechanical Systems — MCQ Practice
note: Original ACADRIX practice MCQs based on the R-2025 Unit IV scope. These are not official university questions or PYQs.

questions.q: Which machine element is primarily used to transmit rotary motion and torque between components?
questions.explanation: A shaft is a rotating machine element designed to transmit torque and rotary motion.

questions.q: What is the primary function of a bearing?
options: Support a rotating shaft and reduce friction
questions.answer: Support a rotating shaft and reduce friction
questions.explanation: Bearings support rotating members while reducing friction and controlling relative motion.

questions.q: Which gear arrangement is commonly used to transmit motion between parallel shafts?
questions.explanation: Spur gears have straight teeth parallel to the shaft axis and are commonly used between parallel shafts.

questions.q: Which gear is generally used when motion must be transmitted between intersecting shafts?
questions.explanation: Bevel gears are designed to transmit motion and power between intersecting shafts.

questions.q: A worm gear drive is especially useful when a large speed reduction is required between shafts that are usually at right angles. What is the driven element called?
questions.explanation: The worm meshes with the worm wheel and can provide substantial speed reduction in a compact arrangement.

questions.q: Which machine element is used to connect two shafts so that torque can be transmitted from one shaft to the other?
questions.explanation: A coupling connects shafts and transmits torque while accommodating the requirements of the shaft system.

questions.q: Which component is commonly used to make a detachable threaded joint?
questions.explanation: Bolts and nuts provide detachable mechanical fastening and can be removed for maintenance.

questions.q: Which fastener is normally tightened by rotating the nut or bolt to develop clamping force?
questions.explanation: Threaded fasteners generate clamping force through the interaction of mating threads during tightening.

questions.q: A key fitted between a shaft and hub is primarily intended to transmit what?
questions.explanation: A key provides a positive connection between a shaft and hub so torque can be transmitted.

questions.q: Which quantity is most directly associated with the twisting action experienced by a shaft?
questions.explanation: Torque is the moment that produces twisting of a shaft and is central to shaft design.

questions.q: Which gear parameter is directly related to the size of gear teeth?
questions.explanation: For metric gears, module is a standard parameter describing tooth size and is related to pitch diameter and number of teeth.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of selecting an appropriate bearing for a machine?
options: To safely support loads and permit required motion
questions.answer: To safely support loads and permit required motion
questions.explanation: Bearing selection depends on load, speed, life, lubrication and operating conditions so the shaft can rotate reliably.

questions.q: Which load acts perpendicular to the axis of a typical shaft?
questions.explanation: A radial load acts perpendicular to the shaft axis, while an axial load acts along the axis.

questions.q: Which load acts along the axis of a shaft?
questions.explanation: An axial load acts parallel to or along the shaft axis.

questions.q: Which bearing type is commonly associated with rolling elements such as balls?
questions.explanation: Ball bearings use balls as rolling elements between races to reduce friction during rotation.

questions.q: Which bearing type uses rollers rather than balls as its rolling elements?
questions.explanation: Roller bearings use cylindrical or other shaped rollers to carry loads between races.

questions.q: Why are machine elements designed with a factor of safety?
options: To provide margin against uncertain loads and failure
To remove the need for material selection
questions.answer: To provide margin against uncertain loads and failure
questions.explanation: A factor of safety provides a design margin because loads, material properties, manufacturing and service conditions may vary.

questions.q: Which consideration is important when selecting a gear for a power-transmission application?
questions.explanation: Gear selection must account for transmitted load or torque, speed, geometry, material, lubrication and operating conditions.

questions.q: Which machine element primarily prevents relative motion between assembled components by clamping them together?
questions.explanation: Fasteners such as bolts, nuts and screws hold components together through mechanical clamping or engagement.

questions.q: Which statement best describes the role of a coupling in a shaft system?
options: It connects shafts and transmits torque
It converts heat directly into pressure
It permanently increases gear tooth size
questions.answer: It connects shafts and transmits torque
questions.explanation: Couplings are used to connect shafts for torque transmission and may also accommodate limited misalignment or other system requirements.

questions.q: Which machine element is most directly associated with reducing friction between a rotating shaft and its support?
questions.explanation: Bearings provide controlled relative motion and reduce friction between moving machine members and their supports.

questions.q: If a machine requires transmission of motion between non-parallel, intersecting shafts, which gear family is generally appropriate?
questions.explanation: Bevel gears are suited to power transmission between intersecting shaft axes.

questions.q: Which pair of properties is especially important for a shaft carrying transmitted torque?
questions.explanation: A shaft must have adequate strength against failure and stiffness to control deformation and alignment under operating loads.

questions.q: Which design approach best reduces the chance of premature machine-element failure?
options: Select components based on loads, operating conditions and safety requirements
Select the cheapest component regardless of load
Use the same component for every application
questions.answer: Select components based on loads, operating conditions and safety requirements
questions.explanation: Reliable machine design requires matching components to actual loads, speed, environment, materials, lubrication, service life and safety requirements.
